title: I used AI tools to build a physics puzzle where you can redraw the track during a run
author: Hour-Cardiologist615
selftext:
I used AI tools for parts of the code art and sound in Draw Your Way. You draw tracks for a hamster and can change the path while it is moving.

The game uses a custom JavaScript physics engine. Drawing and erasing can change the surface while the hamster is touching it so I have been checking those interactions with automated tests as well as actual gameplay.

This clip shows the track being extended during a run. The current build is free to play in a browser with a keyboard and mouse.

[https://mrblum.itch.io/draw-your-way](https://mrblum.itch.io/draw-your-way)

How do you test changing collision geometry when AI is helping you write the physics code?
